name: Huldar
summary: Huldar is stranded on Loch Modan’s southern road after his blast powder delivery is stopped. The dwarven teamster needs help getting the cargo to the southern excavation site, where archaeologists and prospectors need supplies.

sections.title: A Powder Run in Peril
sections.body: Huldar’s damaged wagon leaves him stranded near the lake’s southern bend. Local wildlife and troggs threaten the road, and Dark Iron infiltrators lurk nearby. He needs passing travelers to guard the remaining powder kegs and carry the shipment to the dig.

faq.answer: Huldar is a dwarven teamster stranded beside his wagon on Loch Modan’s southern bank. His blast powder delivery to the nearby excavation site was stopped.
Huldar’s wagon carries barrels of blast powder. Dwarven prospectors and archaeologists at the southern excavation site need the explosives.

faq.q: Why is Huldar stuck on the road?
faq.answer: Hostile beasts, troggs, and Dark Iron dwarf saboteurs threaten the roads through southern Loch Modan. An ambush stopped Huldar’s shipment, so he seeks help guarding and delivering the remaining supplies.

faq.q: Why do the Dark Iron dwarves care about his cargo?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron clan seeks to undermine Ironforge’s presence and historical research throughout Loch Modan. By cutting off blast powder, they can halt excavation and deprive dwarven operations of defensive and industrial supplies.

angles.text: As a dwarf, helping Huldar supports the Explorer's League dig site and supplies your kin with powder to unearth ancient titan secrets.
As an engineer, you know raw blast powder is valuable and volatile, especially in exposed wooden barrels.
